label: Buttons
when: every button or call to action that leads to a part of the page (book, contact, see the services)
rules: spectra/buttons holds one spectra/button per button; never core buttons. "text" is the plain-text label, "linkURL" a #anchor of this page (or none). Colors are palette slugs: "backgroundColor", "textColor", and for the hover "backgroundColorHover", "textColorHover"; with none, the button wears the site's button style. Main button accent, others primary or secondary. An optional "icon" (an icon name) shows after the text, or before with "iconPosition":"before". No gradients, no other attributes. To center the buttons give spectra/buttons "layout":{"type":"flex","justifyContent":"center"}.
